title: Illinois's 7th Congressional District General Election, 2026
description: The 2026 election for Illinois' 7th Congressional District is an open-seat race following the retirement of longtime Democratic incumbent Rep. Danny Davis, who served from 1997 to 2026. State Representative La Shawn Ford won a crowded 13-candidate Democratic primary on March 17, 2026, with approximately 24% of the vote, after receiving Davis's endorsement. He will face Republican nominee Chad Koppie, a retired pilot and farmer, in the November 3 general election. The district, which includes Chicago's West Side and near western suburbs such as Oak Park and Maywood, is overwhelmingly Democratic (Cook Partisan Voting Index: D+34), making Ford the strong favorite to succeed Davis.
polling_note: No general election polls for Illinois' 7th Congressional District were found as of mid-2026. The Cook Political Report rates the race as 'Solid Democratic'.

candidates.name: La Shawn Ford
candidates.summary: La Shawn Ford is a Democratic member of the Illinois House of Representatives representing the 8th District since 2007. He won the Democratic nomination for Illinois' 7th Congressional District on March 17, 2026, defeating 12 other candidates with approximately 24% of the vote. A former Chicago Public Schools teacher and real estate broker, Ford has focused his legislative career on jobs, criminal justice reform, healthcare access, and education, and was endorsed by retiring incumbent Rep. Danny Davis.

candidates.name: Chad Koppie
candidates.summary: Chad Koppie is a retired jumbo jet pilot, farmer, and U.S. Army veteran who won the Republican nomination for Illinois' 7th Congressional District on March 17, 2026, with approximately 66% of the vote. He has prior political experience as a Rutland Township (Kane County) trustee and school board member for District 300. Koppie campaigned on a platform of a constitutional amendment to ban abortion, cutting federal taxes and spending, border security, and simplifying the tax code to a single-page form.

forecast.rationale: Illinois's 7th Congressional District is an open seat following the retirement of longtime Democratic Rep. Danny Davis, but the district is overwhelmingly Democratic with a Cook PVI of D+34. Democratic nominee La Shawn Ford, a state representative endorsed by Davis, won a 13-candidate primary. Republican nominee Chad Koppie faces very long odds in a district that includes Chicago's West Side and heavily Democratic near-western suburbs. No general election polls are available, which reduces precision, but the district's deeply Democratic fundamentals and the Cook Political Report's 'Solid Democratic' rating make Ford the overwhelming favorite. The open-seat nature and lack of polling cap confidence at 'medium' despite the safe rating.
